notes.title: Germanification
notes.notes:
[b]Hey RPG gamers 🙂 🎉[/b]

we’re excited to announce that “Facing The Rain” is now also available in German. 

All dialogues, menus, inventory items, newspaper articles, steam achievements etc. are fully translated.

We also slightly reworked some of the dialogues and fixed some minor issues.

And finally, “Facing the Rain” now got a custom rain animation 😂 and there’s a little thunderstorm!

[b]Enjoy 🙂[/b]
